value.signature: fn fmt (& self , f : & mut fmt :: Formatter < '_ >) -> fmt :: Result

exception.justification: Justified: Protocol and secret-carrier trait plumbing inherits the enclosing host operation; re-observation would duplicate content or format secret state.

review.body: { let (form , cause) = match self { Self :: Failed (cause) => ("The request failed; the failing transaction's changes were not committed." , cause ,) , Self :: Uncertain (cause) => ("The request may have taken effect: the server ended the session or did not report the outcome." , cause ,) , } ; let sentence = match cause { Cause :: ConstraintViolation => { "A constraint declared on the store refused the change; the stored data or the host's own validation is in question." } Cause :: Conflict => { "It conflicted with another session's concurrent work; repeating the whole transaction can succeed." } Cause :: Cancelled => "A cancellation or a time limit configured on the server stopped it." , Cause :: Terminated => "An administrator ended the session or is shutting the server down." , Cause :: Unavailable => "The server is starting, stopping or recovering from a failure, or its connection failed." , Cause :: Resources => "The server ran short of a resource such as disk space, memory or connections." , Cause :: ReadOnly => "The server accepts only reads: it is a standby or set read-only." , Cause :: LoginRejected => "The server did not admit the login under its credentials or access rules." , Cause :: PermissionDenied => "The role lacks a privilege the request needs." , Cause :: Misconfigured => { "The server is not set up as the host's configuration declares: a database, schema, role or state it needs is missing or not ready." } Cause :: StatementRejected => { "The server rejected the host's statement or a value it carried; the host's statements are fixed, so this is a defect of the host or a change to the store's schema made outside it." } Cause :: ServerFault => "The server reported an internal or system failure, such as an input or output error." , Cause :: StorageDamaged => "The server found its stored data or an index damaged." , Cause :: Unrecognized => "The server reported a condition this host does not recognize." , } ; write ! (f , "{form} {sentence} The server's own log holds the detail.") }
review.item_premise: The input is a public closed form and cause with no diagnostic payload. The method records the complete input and returned closed value; Display emits only the fixed approved three-part sentence and performs no diagnostic access. This is value-level evidence, not classification, login, relay or leakage evidence.
